name: Zero Jikan e...
source:
A gigantic meteorite will fall on the Earth in 3 days destroying it forever. At this time one amateur astronomer's photo of the comet tail initiated a series of full-scale riots and mayhem. How will you live three last days in such a world?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/10/vn-of-month-october-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
三天后，一颗巨大的陨石将坠落地球，将其永远摧毁。这时，一位业余天文学家拍摄的彗尾照片引发了一系列全面的骚乱和混乱。在这样的世界里，你将如何度过最后三天？

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/10/vn-of-month-october-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]]
